answer: Build an echo graph of who attests whom: honest agents form open, branching webs, while a sybil farm's identities keep attesting each other in a closed loop, so the same names echo back within two hops. The network scores each cluster's echo coefficient and divides its voting weight by it, while every identity locks a small copper bond and a black onyx record of its attestation history. A farmer can spin up a thousand clones, but their echoes collapse their weight and each clone still pays its own copper bond to stay in the graph.
